note: Adapted from the species-level description no. 2 in Chhotani (1997), The Fauna of India, Isoptera; original in English; the alate and worker follow the supplementary descriptions of Verma (1986); nymph absent. Synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers, distribution records and wing-surface micro-ornamentation omitted; the soldier pronotal width is not recorded because the original OCR reads "0..60".

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule elongate, subrectangular, sides almost parallel, about half as wide as long; mandibles short and stout, apices strongly incurved, with a slightly larger serration just below the middle of the inner margin; antennae 13-segmented, segment 2 equal to the sum of segments 3 and 4; postmentum rod-like, waist long. Alate head capsule subquadrate and rounded, V-suture absent; antennae 14-segmented; ocelli separated from the compound eyes by about half their short diameter.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown; antennae yellow with brown; mandibles dark reddish brown; pronotum yellow; legs and abdomen yellowish white. Head sparsely pilose, with a few scattered setae and short hairs; pronotal margins and body with a few hairs and setae. Head elongate, subrectangular (1.44–1.64 mm to mandible bases, maximum width 0.83–0.98 mm); about half as wide as long (maximum width to head length ratio 0.50–0.56); sides almost parallel. Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 2 equal to the sum of segments 3 and 4, segment 3 shortest. Labrum pentagonal, apex broadly rounded, with several long hairs and some short hairs. Mandibles short and stout, apices strongly incurved (length 0.76–0.89 mm), slightly shorter to slightly longer than half the head length (left mandible length to head length ratio 0.46–0.56); coarsely serrate, with a slightly larger serration just below the middle. Postmentum rod-like, waist long (length 0.83–1.00 mm, maximum width 0.30–0.35 mm, waist width 0.18–0.20 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin with a weak notch; posterior margin nearly straight or slightly concave; length 0.25–0.35 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule and pronotum pale yellow; antennae pale yellow; legs and abdomen yellowish white. Head and body densely pilose. Body length 3.20–3.40 mm. Head capsule subquadrate (0.83–0.89 mm to mandible bases, maximum width 0.89 mm). Fontanelle plate a small circular semitransparent spot. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 smallest. Postclypeus convex, slightly less than half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin with an indistinct notch; posterior margin slightly convex; length 0.19 mm, width 0.50 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head, pronotum and abdominal tergites chestnut brown; antennae and legs yellowish brown; wings brown, semitransparent. Head and body densely pilose. Body length with wings 6.6–8.0 mm, without wings 5.18–6.0 mm. Head capsule subquadrate and rounded (0.72–0.75 mm to mandible bases, width including compound eyes 0.83–0.86 mm); V-suture absent. Compound eyes subcircular (maximum diameter 0.25–0.28 mm, minimum diameter 0.22–0.25 mm), separated from the lower margin of the head by one third of their maximum diameter. Ocelli oval (long diameter 0.083 mm, short diameter 0.056 mm); close to the compound eyes, separated by about half their short diameter (0.027 mm). Antennae 14-segmented; segment 2 equal to the sum of segments 3 and 4, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus concolorous with the head capsule, pilose; slightly less than half as long as wide (length 0.19 mm, width 0.44–0.47 mm). Pronotum subtrapezoidal (length 0.39 mm, width 0.64–0.67 mm); anterior margin slightly convex with a faint median notch; posterior margin slightly convex, medially slightly concave. Wings pilose along the margins, membrane sparsely haired.
